items.html: *And behold, in the matter of the sawing of the judgments there are two aspects. The first is to draw all the judgments that are in his Keter and place them in her Keter, and those of his Hochma in her Hochma, and so on until the completion of his ten Sefirot in her ten Sefirot. The second aspect is that the ten Sefirot in her stand from his Chazeh downward; therefore the judgments in the lower half of his Tifferet must be given in her Keter, and the judgments in the first section of his Netzah in her Hochma, and likewise until the completion of his NNH throughout her entire stature.
